h1: Baan Paknam Hotel Samut Prakan — A Clean Budget Hotel Near BTS Pak Nam
intro: If you want an affordable place to stay in Pak Nam with clean, spacious rooms within walking distance of the BTS, Baan Paknam Hotel is a 2-star hotel that guests single out for cleanliness, rooms that feel brand new, and a location close to both BTS Sai Luat and BTS Pak Nam. It sits on Sai Luat Road in Pak Nam, Mueang Samut Prakan, near a 7-Eleven and local restaurants. There's free parking, free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk. Prices start from approx. ฿550/night, and it holds a 9.5 score from 57 real guest reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: The main reason guests praise Baan Paknam is cleanliness and rooms that feel brand new. Many reviews describe tidy, spacious rooms with roomy bathrooms that give the impression of a recently opened hotel. The cleanliness category scores 9.8 on Trip.com — very high for a budget property. For anyone who wants a clean place to sleep for a few hundred baht, this hits the mark squarely.

The other selling point is a Pak Nam location within walking distance of the BTS. The hotel is on Sai Luat Road, around 500–800 metres from BTS Sai Luat and within easy reach of BTS Pak Nam (Green Line) for getting into Bangkok. A 7-Eleven, local restaurants and the Pak Nam market are all close by for food. It suits travellers here on business in Pak Nam, connecting onward, or using the BTS as a budget base for exploring Bangkok.

Facilities are those of a budget hotel, but genuinely useful. There's free parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, a laundry room and a taxi-booking service. Some rooms have a private balcony. Staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful, with the service category at 9.6. There's no breakfast and no pool, which is normal for a hotel at this level.
"The room was clean, spacious and felt new. You can walk to the BTS, and it's close to 7-Eleven and restaurants — easy to get around and great value. The best hotel in this area."

The thing to know upfront is that street-facing rooms can be noisy. Some reviews note that traffic passing at night made it hard to sleep, since Sai Luat Road is a main road. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a room that doesn't face the street at check-in. Beyond that, in-room amenities are basic — there are no hairdryers in the rooms (request one at the front desk), and there's no breakfast.

It's also worth understanding that this is a budget hotel in Pak Nam town, not an airport transit hotel near Suvarnabhumi. The airport is about a 40–50 minute drive away, so it isn't the choice for very early flights where you want to be next to the terminal. But if your goal is business in Pak Nam, taking the BTS into Bangkok, or simply finding a clean, cheap bed, this location works far better than a hotel out in the Bang Phli area.

Overall, Baan Paknam Hotel holds a 9.5 out of 10 on Trip.com from 57 real guest reviews — very high for a 2-star property. It's the right pick for travellers who prioritise a clean room, a budget price, and getting around by BTS. Prices start around ฿550 and climb with the season and room type into the high hundreds to low thousands. If you can live with street noise and don't need breakfast or a pool, it offers value that's hard to find in Pak Nam.

faqTitle: FAQ — Baan Paknam Hotel, Samut Prakan

faq.q: Where is Baan Paknam Hotel and how do you get there?
faq.a: The hotel is on Sai Luat Road in Pak Nam, Mueang Samut Prakan. It's around 500–800 metres' walk to BTS Sai Luat (Green Line) and within easy reach of BTS Pak Nam for getting into Bangkok. A 7-Eleven and local restaurants are close by. Suvarnabhumi Airport is about a 40–50 minute drive.

faq.q: What are the room prices and room types at Baan Paknam Hotel?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿550/night for a Standard Room. Options range from Superior and Deluxe (some with a balcony) up to a Family Room. Rates climb with the season and room type into the high hundreds to low thousands — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Baan Paknam Hotel have breakfast and a pool?
faq.a: No — there's no breakfast and no swimming pool, as it's a 2-star budget hotel. It does offer free parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, a laundry room and a taxi-booking service. A 7-Eleven and restaurants nearby make finding breakfast easy.

faq.q: Are the rooms clean and is it noisy at Baan Paknam Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms earn high praise for cleanliness — the cleanliness category scores 9.8 on Trip.com, and rooms feel new and spacious. However, rooms facing Sai Luat Road can be noisy at night from passing traffic, so light sleepers should ask for an inner room at check-in.

faq.q: Who is Baan Paknam Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who prioritise a clean room, a budget price, and getting around by BTS — on business in Pak Nam, or using the BTS as a cheap base for Bangkok. It's less suited to those who want breakfast, a pool, or a hotel by the airport for very early flights.

faq.q: Does Baan Paknam Hotel have parking?
faq.a: Yes — there's free on-site parking, but spaces are limited. If you're driving and arriving in the evening, it's worth checking with the front desk first. A past review noted some communication over parking, so confirm the details clearly at check-in.
